note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation trophy list (kit starter data, verified against the published Exophase list). Guides are written in our own words from published guides; sources are cited per trophy.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no shortcut: the road runs through the story, the 100% checklist and the long tail of side content — about 200 hours in total. Use the Roadmap view to plan the three phases and tick trophies off here as you go.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the game. It unlocks as the story begins and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 1 by playing through its main missions. Tip for the whole run: keep a manual save at the end of each chapter — you get 15 manual save slots plus one autosave, and there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 4. It unlocks after the chapter's final main mission, 'Starting From Zero'.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) only appears after you finish the story, and progress made during the story counts toward it. In practice it is about 60% of true completion: 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 of 397 stunts, 100 optional missions, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations. Budget roughly 100 hours for this phase — it is the longest grind in the game, and it unlocks this gold.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
trophies.target: 100% completion — 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 300 of 397 stunts, 100 optional missions

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. The game tracks 397 in total across four types: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. Use the map filter Exploration > Stunt Spots to find them, and check progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts. You need 300 for 100% completion, so keep going past this trophy.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Filter the map by Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) to find them. You will do one of each naturally while chasing the 100% checklist, so don't force it early.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 range locations. Gold takes fast, accurate shooting — use a stable weapon and learn each challenge's target pattern. Ranges are marked on the map, and you can retry any challenge as often as you like.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total, 3 per location). Drone races are marked on the map once the area is unfogged. Learn each course's racing line — you only need one win per location, not every race.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations across Leonida — street races, off-road and more. Any 20 distinct race wins count; repeat wins at the same location do not stack. Race markers appear on the map as you explore.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui' (where you meet Cal), he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento — a purple map icon. Go there and beat him at fishing, using the same fishing mechanics as anywhere else.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Four video games exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home — interact with the controllers, available from Chapter 1 — and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. 'Complete' means finishing all levels of one game at least once; you don't need every challenge. Pick the game you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3: Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Complete all 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. Every quest stays available after the story, so nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1, a while after the mission 'Island Dreams' (Work for Kenton): he calls, then appears as the green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons — dive for treasure at 7 shipwrecks with the metal detector and bring the loot back. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (as Jason he texts you; calling Brian as Jason speeds it up). Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's questline unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break' and is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all 5 jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler), Hometown Heroes. All quests remain available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — the character questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie) do NOT count. Confirmed counting strands: Kirk (Skunk Ape — Skunk Apeology 101, tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street race, Bumper to Bumper, race against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile parts, Pete's Deliveries). All remain available after the story; track progress in the trophy list.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's 'Wish List' starts after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' (steal the Zorrusso for Randy), which also unlocks the Key Cloner. He wants 16 high-end sports cars delivered to his garage (green 'RK' icon, west Vice City). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether a car is on the list, then drive it back — good condition pays more. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. The Zorrusso itself is delivered during the story mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty': purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City. Destroy the labs ('Take Out Kitty Litter'), then Tyrone gives the second quest 'Spin On This' — shut the labs down for good. Available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONLY (POSSIBLY) MISSABLE TROPHY IN THE GAME: the very first meditation happens at Jason's house during Chapter 1 only. After the mission 'Down to Earth', Lucia mentions meditating in the morning — talk to her in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose 'Accept'. It is not yet confirmed whether that Chapter 1 meditation is required for the trophy (it adds +1 but isn't listed as a formal spot), so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. You can't do the final meditation until both characters can play together (after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break').
trophies.missable_note: Only possible missable in the game: the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house disappears after Chapter 1. Do it before finishing Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
trophies.when: Chapter 1 — do the house meditation before Chapter 1 ends

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break': Bret texts Jason and marks the first quest 'Veteran Hunted' in Lummox County. He gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker) and marks hunting spots with purple icons. Bring the animals he requests back to him. Track the 15 Target Decks under Map > Activities > Target Deck — you need all 15 for 100% anyway, so this comes naturally.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card set locations across Leonida; collect the cards in any 3 complete sets. Cards are a collectible type — use the map and your collection tracker to find them.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold Up + R1 to scan objects in the environment. There are far more than 100 scannable spots — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and more — so just scan as you explore and this pops naturally. Scanning also feeds vehicle discovery and 100% progress.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in total and you only need 50 for this trophy; 70 are needed for 100% completion, so this unlocks automatically on the way to the gold. View them under Progress > Challenges. Save the quick, easy ones for last and pick what suits your playstyle.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. First possible after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', when you can free-roam with both characters together (call your partner with Right + Triangle). Cause chaos until you hit 4 stars, then escape in a fast sports motorcycle and leave the red heat zone — the trophy pops once you drive out of the heat area. Easy route: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) — cops struggle to follow and the helicopter can't see you. It also unlocks automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' and while robbing the 8 bank vaults.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Available after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break'. Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level (not the red heat level) the whole time, and loot 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing; call your partner with Right + Triangle. A good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (available after Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'). The pop is delayed — it triggers about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it doesn't pop, hit a 4th shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it instantly) and scan vehicles with R1 — scanning is enough, you don't need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. There are 557 vehicles at launch; you need 200 base-model scans for 100%, so this comes automatically. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted; it drains the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or a wash/shower at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend it. Line up 5 enemies — gang-operation criminals work best — and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556. It doesn't seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); you raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal (connected to a boarding bridge — the planes parked on the airfield don't count). Easiest: the plane at terminals E3/E4 — drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. Tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in, and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' — it unlocks the Snap Gun (silent lockpick for alarmed doors) and marks jewelry-store robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (don't kick the door — that triggers the alarm), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. Good spot: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' (it appears from story progress): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and rob it — bring your partner and hand off a bag (hold Right). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple icons) — you need his earlier quests done first (2 Payday Loans robberies). Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and you need all 8 for 100%, so this pops on the way. Up to $205,000 per bank — the best money in the endgame.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. This unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. You can also do it earlier: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is fully visible. Do this early and often, since unfogging also reveals race, activity and collectible markers.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; you only need one per gang for this trophy, but all 39 are required for 100%. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them (many are marked automatically through the story). Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first (Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'). Only the blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. The pop is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. During the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling' (marked automatically), rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations. Grab all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later — you don't need all 3 in one visit, so it's not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Available after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break'. Work out at a fitness club (filter Map > Activities for gyms) — always bring your partner (Right + Triangle to call them): while one character trains, the other completes their training automatically, doubling progress. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Profiles range from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes) to Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable (excessive violence). Almost every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this comes passively while chasing everything else. If you're short at the end, the fastest farm is running over civilians and cops — but expect them to shoot on sight at Psycho/Irredeemable.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. During the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans store — come back later as Lucia alone (no Jason) and rob the same store again, then escape on foot. First possible after Chapter 3's 'Credit Check' (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. Go to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City: aim at the teller, deal with security, break through the door and empty the 3 cash drawers, then run — the trophy only counts if you escape on foot, not in a vehicle, and the pop is delayed until you're clear of the search area.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2 AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it's not there, drive away and come back (the spawn is slightly random). Follow the path into the woods from the car and you'll see the UFO (bright blue light in the sky). Approach it: it drops an abducted woman — talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
trophies.when: Any time, at night after 2 AM

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish Chapter 3's 'Credit Check' to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a Fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each, so this comes naturally while doing the 100% robberies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn money — Ammu-Nation, mod shops and tattoo studios are the most expensive. Any shop spending counts toward the cumulative total.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the 8 purchasable garages (4 story garages don't count), $160,000 in total. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver' (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone. Buy them through the app. Robberies — especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4 — are the quickest way to fund them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses' (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose 'Respray' then 'Register' in his garage. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
